reports.title: Where am I
reports.query:
// CARD - "Where am I" (report type: Table, single row)
// The breadcrumb from Pathao Pay down to the node currently in focus,
// plus the filter the transactions table is currently applying - so it
// is always visible why the dataframe holds the rows it holds.
// Falls back to 'root' when the focus parameter points at a key that no
// longer exists - see the note in card2_expansion_graph.cypher.
WITH coalesce($neodash_focus, 'root') AS fk
OPTIONAL MATCH (stale:Nav {key: fk})
WITH CASE WHEN stale IS NULL THEN 'root' ELSE fk END AS fk
MATCH (f:Nav {key: fk})
MATCH (n:Nav) WHERE f.path STARTS WITH n.path
WITH f, n ORDER BY n.level
WITH f, collect(n.name) AS trail
WITH f, trail,
     [x IN [
       CASE WHEN f.f_acc  IS NOT NULL THEN 'STATEMENT_FOR_ACC = ' + f.f_acc  ELSE null END,
       CASE WHEN f.f_dc   IS NOT NULL THEN 'TXN_TYPE_D_C = '      + f.f_dc   ELSE null END,
       CASE WHEN f.f_type IS NOT NULL THEN 'TXN_TYPE = '          + f.f_type ELSE null END,
       CASE WHEN f.f_cp   IS NOT NULL THEN 'TXN_WITH_ACC = '      + f.f_cp   ELSE null END
     ] WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS filters
RETURN f.level AS LEVEL,
       f.name  AS FOCUS,
       reduce(s = '', x IN trail   | CASE WHEN s = '' THEN x ELSE s + '  >  '   + x END) AS BREADCRUMB,
       CASE WHEN size(filters) = 0 THEN 'all rows (sampled)'
            ELSE reduce(s = '', x IN filters | CASE WHEN s = '' THEN x ELSE s + '  AND  ' + x END)
       END AS TABLE_FILTER,
       CASE WHEN f.click = 'root' AND f.key <> 'root'
            THEN 'end of branch - click to restart' ELSE '' END AS NOTE

settings.description: Path from Pathao Pay to the node in focus, and the filter the table is applying.
